conventions: Today's date for all questions is 2026-01-01. Data covers 2023-01-01 to 2025-12-31.
Business metrics exclude test accounts (customers.is_test_account = 1) unless a question says otherwise.
subscriptions.end_date is exclusive: it is the first day the subscription is no longer active. NULL means still running.

A subscription is active on date D if start_date <= D, (end_date IS NULL OR end_date > D), and status is not 'paused'. The status column records only the current state, so use dates, not status, to decide whether a subscription was active at a past date.
A plan change ends the old subscription (status 'cancelled', cancel_reason 'plan_change') and starts a new one on the same day. It is not a customer cancellation.

terms.definition: A non-test customer with at least one subscription that is active on the reference date. Subscription activity is decided by dates as defined in the conventions: start_date <= D and (end_date IS NULL OR end_date > D), excluding paused subscriptions. When a question gives no date, the reference date is today (2026-01-01).

As of a reference date D: the sum, over subscriptions active on D that belong to non-test customers, of the monthly-normalized list price of the subscription's plan. Monthly billing uses plans.monthly_price. Annual billing uses plans.annual_price divided by 12. Prices come from the plans table and no discounts exist.

For a period from P_start (inclusive) to P_end (exclusive): the number of non-test customers active on P_start who are not active on P_end, divided by the number of non-test customers active on P_start. Customers not active on P_start are excluded from both numerator and denominator. A customer who changes plan stays active. A customer who cancels and re-subscribes within the period and is active on P_end is not churned. For a calendar quarter, P_start is the quarter's first day and P_end is the first day of the next quarter (Q1 2025 runs from 2025-01-01 to 2025-04-01).

For a period, by invoice_date: the sum of (amount - refunded_amount) over invoices of non-test customers whose status is 'paid' or 'refunded'. A 'refunded' invoice was collected and then refunded in full or in part, so only the unrefunded remainder counts. Invoices with status 'failed' were never collected and contribute nothing.
MRR divided by the number of active customers, both measured on the same reference date and both excluding test accounts.
One minus the churn rate for the same period, using the churn rate definition above.

For a support ticket: resolved_at minus created_at, expressed in hours. Only tickets with a non-NULL resolved_at are included, so unresolved tickets are excluded from counts and averages. Tickets belonging to test accounts are excluded.
